items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I don’t want to because you’re not going to play it as good as Glenn Miller

ctx.x: Well you know, you should have learned. You worked with one drummer and had to deal with all his things, and now you’ve got a whole new set.

Well she’s a joy. Sherrie makes me proud. She is dedicated, she cares. And like I say she’s the backbone of the band. She keeps it going. Her musicianship is superb, she’s a fine arranger and a wonderful composer. And we’re proud. It’s difficult at times because like with the male band, if you lose a bass player you can get 20 guys to play. Our book is very difficult. And the ladies come out of North Texas State, Berklee, like little Karolina, and Anat Cohen, they’re all musicians, studied. And it’s difficult…
That’s got to be really gratifying—
